schema.text: Which of these best describe your current work or study situation? If you both study and work, you can choose two answers.

options.text: Work through an app or platform (e.g. delivery rider, ride-hailing driver)
Caring full-time for a family member
Not working because of health problems or disability

it.#Which of these best describe your curre: Quale di queste descrive meglio la tua attuale situazione lavorativa o di studio? Se studi e lavori, puoi scegliere due risposte.
it.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): Lavoro autonomo o libera professione (tempo pieno)
it.#Business owner or entrepreneur: Ho un'impresa o un'attività in proprio
it.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Lavoro tramite app o piattaforma (es. rider per consegne, autista NCC tramite app)
it.#Homemaker: Persona che si occupa della casa
it.#Caring full-time for a family member: Mi occupo a tempo pieno di una persona della mia famiglia
it.#Unemployed looking for work: Senza lavoro, in cerca di occupazione
it.#Unemployed not looking for work: Senza lavoro, non in cerca di occupazione
it.#Not working because of health problems: Non lavoro a causa di problemi di salute o disabilità

fr.#Which of these best describe your curre: Laquelle de ces situations décrit le mieux votre activité professionnelle ou vos études actuelles ? Si vous étudiez et travaillez, vous pouvez choisir deux réponses.
fr.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): Travail indépendant ou en freelance (temps plein)
fr.#Self-employed or freelance (part-time): Travail indépendant ou en freelance (temps partiel)
fr.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Travail via une application ou une plateforme (par ex. livraisons à domicile, transport de personnes en VTC)
fr.#Caring full-time for a family member: Soins à temps plein à une personne de la famille
fr.#Unemployed looking for work: Sans emploi et à la recherche d’un emploi
fr.#Unemployed not looking for work: Sans emploi et ne recherchant pas d’emploi
fr.#Not working because of health problems: Sans activité professionnelle en raison de problèmes de santé ou d’un handicap

de.#Which of these best describe your curre: Welche dieser Angaben beschreibt Ihre aktuelle Arbeits- oder Ausbildungssituation am besten? Wenn Sie sowohl lernen oder studieren als auch arbeiten, können Sie zwei Antworten auswählen.
de.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Arbeit über eine App oder Plattform (z. B. Essenslieferungen, Fahrdienste über eine App)
de.#Caring full-time for a family member: Pflege oder Betreuung eines Familienmitglieds in Vollzeit
de.#Not working because of health problems: Nicht berufstätig wegen gesundheitlicher Probleme oder einer Behinderung

tr.#Which of these best describe your curre: Aşağıdakilerden hangisi şu anki çalışma veya öğrenim durumunuzu en iyi tanımlar? Hem okuyor hem çalışıyorsanız iki yanıt seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#Occasional or on-call work: Ara sıra veya çağrı üzerine çalışıyorum
tr.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): Kendi hesabıma veya serbest çalışıyorum (tam zamanlı)
tr.#Self-employed or freelance (part-time): Kendi hesabıma veya serbest çalışıyorum (yarı zamanlı)
tr.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Bir uygulama veya platform üzerinden çalışıyorum (ör. kurye, araç çağırma uygulaması sürücüsü)
tr.#Caring full-time for a family member: Tam zamanlı olarak bir aile üyesine bakıyorum
tr.#Not working because of health problems: Sağlık sorunları veya engellilik nedeniyle çalışmıyorum

fa.#Which of these best describe your curre: کدام یک از این گزینه‌ها وضعیت فعلی کار یا تحصیل شما را بهتر توصیف می‌کند؟ اگر هم تحصیل می‌کنید و هم کار، می‌توانید دو پاسخ انتخاب کنید.
fa.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: کار از طریق اپلیکیشن یا پلتفرم (مثلاً پیک تحویل سفارش، رانندگی در تاکسی اینترنتی)
fa.#Student (school, university or training: در حال تحصیل (مدرسه، دانشگاه یا دوره آموزشی)
fa.#Caring full-time for a family member: مراقبت تمام‌وقت از یکی از اعضای خانواده
fa.#Unemployed not looking for work: بیکار و در حال حاضر جویای کار نیستم
fa.#Not working because of health problems: به دلیل مشکلات سلامتی یا معلولیت کار نمی‌کنم

hu.#Which of these best describe your curre: Melyik írja le legjobban jelenlegi munka- vagy tanulmányi helyzetét? Ha tanul és dolgozik is, két választ is megjelölhet.
hu.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): Önálló vállalkozó vagy szabadúszó vagyok (teljes munkaidőben)
hu.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Alkalmazáson vagy platformon keresztül dolgozom (pl. futárként vagy személyszállító alkalmazás sofőrjeként)
hu.#Student (school, university or training: Tanuló vagy hallgató vagyok (iskola, egyetem vagy képzés)
hu.#Unemployed not looking for work: Munkanélküli vagyok és jelenleg nem keresek munkát
hu.#Not working because of health problems: Egészségügyi probléma vagy fogyatékosság miatt nem dolgozom

ar.#Which of these best describe your curre: أي من هذه الخيارات يصف وضعك الحالي في العمل أو الدراسة بشكل أفضل؟ في حال الجمع بين الدراسة والعمل، يمكنك اختيار إجابتين.
ar.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): أعمل لحسابي الخاص أو بشكل حر (بدوام كامل)
ar.#Self-employed or freelance (part-time): أعمل لحسابي الخاص أو بشكل حر (بدوام جزئي)
ar.#Business owner or entrepreneur: أملك نشاطًا تجاريًا أو أدير مشروعًا خاصًا
ar.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: أعمل عبر تطبيق أو منصة (مثل توصيل الطلبات أو خدمات النقل عبر التطبيقات)
ar.#Student (school, university or training: أدرس (في المدرسة أو الجامعة أو في تدريب)
ar.#Caring full-time for a family member: أعتني بدوام كامل بأحد أفراد العائلة
ar.#Unemployed not looking for work: لا أعمل ولا أبحث عن عمل حاليًا
ar.#Not working because of health problems: لا أعمل بسبب مشكلات صحية أو إعاقة
